  }
}
'@ | Set-Content -Path '.chunkhound.json' -Encoding utf8
# Configure Codex to connect to ChunkHound via MCP.
codex mcp add ChunkHound -- chunkhound mcp
# Build ChunkHound's search index for this project.
chunkhound index .
